headline: Perseus Mining Reports Nyanzaga Gold Mine in Tanzania Reaches 88% Completion
summary: Perseus Mining stated that its Nyanzaga gold project in Tanzania is 88.4% complete. First gold production is scheduled for January 2027, although overall construction expenses will surpass the originally approved budget.
why: Mining construction progress and budget revisions in East Africa affect gold supply schedules and operator capital expenditure balances.

impacts.name: Perseus Mining Ltd
impacts.why: Construction is near completion, but final project costs will exceed the initial budget.
